description: This file defines the class `Zend_Http_UserAgent_Text`, which is a subclass of `Zend_Http_UserAgent_AbstractDevice`. It provides methods to identify text-based browsers or user agents, detecting characteristics like supported features, markup formats, and device capabilities.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Text
classes.description: A class representing text-based user agent types, capable of pattern matching and feature detection for text browsers.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Static method that matches a user agent string against known text browser signatures.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string 'text', indicating the type of user agent.

methods.name: _defineFeatures
methods.description: Defines features supported by this user agent, such as images, iframes, frames, and javascript support.

methods.name: getImageFormatSupport
methods.description: Returns null; no specific image formats are supported.

methods.name: getPreferredMarkup
methods.description: Returns the string 'xhtml' as the preferred markup format.

methods.name: getXhtmlSupportLevel
methods.description: Returns integer 1, representing the level of XHTML support.

methods.name: hasFlashSupport
methods.description: Returns false; flash support is not available.

methods.name: hasPdfSupport
methods.description: Returns false; PDF support is not available.
